name: What is the difference between builder-grade and high-end bathroom fixtures?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between builder-grade and high-end bathroom fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-end designer fixtures offer solid brass internal components, superior ceramic disc cartridges, and durable physical vapor deposition (PVD) finishes that resist corrosion and tarnishing. Standard builder-grade fixtures often rely on plastic internal waterways and lighter-gauge metal shells, which can wear down sooner under hard water conditions. While builder-grade products save money upfront, premium fixtures provide smoother handle operation, lower risk of internal seal failure, and longer service life. Weigh your long-term plans for the home against your initial renovation budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-end fixtures feature solid brass construction, durable PVD finishes, and commercial-grade cartridges, while builder-grade units use more plastic components.
